seoTitle: How do you prepare for your move?
seoDesc: Moving soon? In this article, find all our advice to help you prepare for your move as well as possible.
h1: Preparing your move well: the essential steps

intro.p: Changing home often means a fresh start. But before you put down your bags in your new home, there is one step you can't skip: preparing the move. Organisation, administrative formalities, sorting, packing… Good preparation makes the whole process much calmer.

sections.h: Six to eight weeks before the move: plan ahead to cope better

body.p: The key to a successful move is to start early. As a general rule, it is recommended to begin the process about two months before the planned date.

sections.h: Choose a date and book your removal company

body.p: Some months, such as June or September, are particularly busy. It is therefore best to lock in the date as early as possible, especially if you plan to use a professional removal company.

Moving is the ideal opportunity to declutter! Before even thinking about boxes, sort through your clothes, furniture and unused appliances. You can sell, give away or recycle whatever you no longer need.

sections.h: One month before: time to get organised

body.p: Changing address involves several formalities. These are the main ones:

ul: Notify your energy, water, phone and internet providers
Inform your health insurer, bank, employer, the children's school and so on
Update your home insurance to the new address

body.p: If you are a tenant, make sure to tell your landlord well in advance. The notice period depends on your tenancy agreement.
Don't fall into the trap of “I'll do it next weekend”. The earlier you start, the more efficiently you can pack. Begin with the items you use least (decorations, out-of-season clothes, books…).
Tip: write the contents and the destination room on each box. This will save you precious time when you move in.
The home straight is often the most intense, but also the most important.

Prepare a bag or crate with the essentials for the first few days: clothes, toiletries, medication, chargers, important papers, basic crockery. That way you won't have to unpack everything on the first evening.

sections.h: Clean and carry out the inventory check

body.p: If you are leaving a rented property, you will need to hand it back in good condition and carry out an exit inventory with the owner or an expert. You need this document to get your rental deposit back.
The big day is here. Here is a short list of things not to forget:

ul: Be present when the removers arrive
Have something ready to welcome them (water, coffee, access to the toilet)
Check that everything is properly loaded and secured
Do a last walk-round of the empty property to make sure nothing has been left behind

sections.h: And afterwards? Don't forget the official change of address

body.p: Once settled in, you have eight days to declare your change of address to your new municipality. In Brussels, you can do this via the IRISbox platform.

Once the declaration is received, a local officer will come to check that you really live at your new address. After validation, your address is updated in the national register and your identity documents must be updated (ID card, driving licence…).

sections.h: Conclusion: a well-prepared move means one less worry

body.p: Preparing a move cannot be improvised. With good preparation, efficient organisation and a little forward planning, you will go through this stage more calmly. Get help from professionals for the most complex tasks. Our removal company supports you at every stage of your project.
